resources.string: Shows live status and controls while recording audio
Shows auto-recording standby status and Android restriction alerts
Android 10+ background mic restrictions prevent silent auto-start. Tap here to start recording.

1. Two-Way Audio Reality: Starting with Android 10, standard third-party apps cannot capture both sides of a cellular voice call unless privileged system permissions are granted by the device manufacturer. On standard devices, this app records via your microphone (capturing your voice, and the caller only if loudspeaker is audible).

2. Legal & Privacy Notice: Never record conversations secretly. Always inform call participants and comply with local wiretapping/consent laws before recording.

3. Local-Only Storage: Your audio files stay strictly on your device unless you explicitly export or share them.
